title: The One It Happens To
label: ch:bn-the-one-it-happens-to
canDo: I can mark the person a thing is done to, say me, you and him as objects, and ask who?

payoff.summary: The object ending goes on living nouns only — the animacy question paying for the third time — and fills the slot in chapter nine's dative frame, which had been taught with nothing to put in it for twenty-seven chapters.
payoff.note: The dative frame of BN-C09-bhalo-laga was taught with no filler: good sticks to me, with no word for me. This chapter supplies it.
